services.name: Cabin Safety
services.desc: FlightSafety prepares private aviation cabin attendants to ensure the safety of their passengers. Our in-depth curriculum uses scenario-based cabin safety exercises in the classroom and in specialized training devices to provide these professionals with the knowledge and skills necessary to efficiently manage any situation-routine or emergency. Our safety-focused training is available at our Learning Centers in Dallas, Texas; Long Beach, California; Paris-Le Bourget, France; Savannah, Georgia; and Teterboro, New Jersey. Courses meet FAR 91, 125, most 135, and NBAA, EBAA, and IS-BAH best practices. Please note that these courses are specifically designed for private aviation cabin attendants
